channel.title: Twynity Changelog
channel.description: Everything new, improved, and fixed in Twynity.

item.title: Your studio, your way (v1.5.0)
item.description: Start a twyn in the mode you want, upgrade without losing your footage, and always know where you stand on credits.

item.title: Avatars that move, and a clearer upgrade moment (v1.4.0)
item.description: Free twyns now come to life with a ready-made moving avatar, and the path to making one truly yours got a lot clearer.

item.title: Onboarding & tiers (v1.3.0)
item.description: A guided two-video capture, voice recording in the same flow, and a free trial that never puts a paywall in your way.

item.title: Studio foundations (v1.2.0)
item.description: The live studio, the equip panel, and the marketplace — the core of talking to and teaching your twyn.
